script.title: Previous Year vs Assessment Year
script.caption_hook: Earn first, tax next! Previous Year vs Assessment Year made simple

lines.say: Ma'am, I earn money this year, but the tax comes next year?
Yes! Income is earned first and taxed later. That gives us two different years.
Two years? Which one is which?
The year you earn income is the previous year. The next year, when it is taxed, is the assessment year.
So salary earned in 2025-26 is taxed in which year?
Add one year. Salary earned in 2025-26 is taxed in the assessment year 2026-27.
Can I choose January to December as my previous year?
No. For every assessee, the year runs from 1 April to 31 March. Books may follow another year, but tax doesn't.
Oh! So is the previous year always twelve months?
Not always. For a new business, the first previous year starts on the set-up date and ends on 31 March.
Then does the assessment year also get shorter?
Never. An assessment year is always twelve months, starting on 1 April.
Got it! P comes before A, so previous comes first!
Exactly! Remember: previous year earns, assessment year taxes.

check_notes: Checker: Line 13 (boy) + Line 14 (teacher 'Exactly!'): the mnemonic 'P comes before A, so previous comes first' is false. In the alphabet A comes before P, so the memory aid points the wrong way, and the teacher endorses it. Correct version: drop the alphabet link and use the meaning instead, e.g. Line 13: 'Got it! Previous means before, so the previous year comes first!' The Line 14 board 'PY earns, AY taxes' is fine.

Checker: Line 2 / Line 4 / Line 6: 'Income is earned first and taxed later' is stated as an absolute rule. Under the Income-tax Act, 1961 there are exceptions where income is assessed in the previous year itself: non-resident shipping business (s.172), persons leaving India (s.174), AOP/BOI formed for a particular event (s.174A), persons likely to transfer property to avoid tax (s.175), and discontinued business (s.176). Correct version: add 'as a general rule' (e.g. 'Generally, income is earned first and taxed later'), or briefly note that a few exceptions exist.

Checker: Line 1 / Line 2: 'the tax comes next year' could suggest that no tax is paid during the year of earning. In fact, TDS and advance tax are paid during the previous year itself; it is the assessment of that income that happens in the assessment year. Suggested wording: 'income is earned in one year and assessed in the next year'.
